parse.title: Mage Arena II/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
'''Beware: Caution must be taken in the [[Wilderness]] getting to the arena and during large parts of the miniquest where [[Player killing|player killers]] can attack you.'''

=== Starting out ===
{{Needed|Item to cut web outside of Mage Arena bank, such as [[knife]], [[slash weapon]] or any [[Wilderness sword]].}}
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Kolodion]] at the [[Mage Arena]] bank located in level 53 [[Wilderness]] to receive an [[enchanted symbol]]. {{Chat option|3Are there any more challenges available?|1Great, I've been waiting for an improvement!}}
}}

=== Locating the followers ===
<!-- this isn't using the regular map template because it's not really possible to do multiple different boundaries in the same map with it, the "geojson" stuff is hugely bloating so is in mapspace and transcluded here-->
{{Map:God followers spawn locations}}
{{Needed|[[Enchanted symbol]], energy potions such as [[stamina potion|stamina]], food, item to cut web|recommended=Teleport item such as [[amulet of glory]], an [[antipoison]].}}
{{Checklist|
*Use the [[enchanted symbol]] in various areas in the Wilderness by process of "[[hot & cold]]", to find the location a follower spawns in. The location is random and different for each player, and changes occasionally.
}}
{{clear}}

{{Needed|[[Enchanted symbol]], [[god staff]], runes for 50+ casts of a [[god spell]] ([[File:Blood rune.png]] [[blood rune]]s, [[File:Fire rune.png]] [[fire rune]]s, [[File:Air rune.png]] [[air rune]]s), food, [[blighted super restore|restore potions]], energy potions such as [[stamina potion|stamina]], item to cut web|recommended=Teleport item such as [[amulet of glory]], an [[antipoison]] potion if near [[poison spider]]s.}}
{{Checklist|
*Bring the appropriate [[god staff]] for the first follower you choose to kill and enough runes for at least 50 casts of the respective [[god spell]].
*Go to the location of the follower you choose to kill and use the [[enchanted symbol]] to spawn the follower.
*Kill the follower that spawns and pick up the remains it drops.
*Go to [[Kolodion]] and give him the remains. This can be done one at a time or all at once. 
*At the bank, refill your runes and supplies and switch to the [[god staff]] that matches your next follower. Repeat the above for the remaining two followers, going to Kolodion after each kill to give the dropped remains.
*'''Congratulations, miniquest complete!'''
}}
